fields.name: gene
fields.description: Ensembl ID using official IGVF GENCODE version (V43)

fields.name: gene_symbol
fields.description: Gene symbol from official IGVF GENCODE version (V43)

fields.name: promoter_coordinates
fields.description: The hg38 coordinates used for the targeted promoter element. N/A

fields.name: log2FC
fields.description: Log2 of the fold change of mean program scores for those cells with perturbation vs reference group. Positive values indicate the mean program score increases with the perturbation, a negative value indicates the mean program score decreases

fields.name: reference_group
fields.description: Flexible tag describing the role of the guides used as a reference group to calculate a log2FC

fields.name: test_statistic
fields.description: Test statistic for difference in program scores between cells that were perturbed with cells that were not perturbed

fields.name: p_nominal_nlog10
fields.description: -log10 uncorrected nominal p-value for test statistic. If not available, NaN

fields.name: fdr_nlog10
fields.description: -log10 p-value corrected for multiple hypothesis testing, as appropriate for this experiment. If not available, NaN

fields.name: fdr_method
fields.description: Method used for multiple testing correction, e.g. 'Bonferroni', 'permutation', 'Benjamini-Hochberg', …
